summary: Iter31 verifies OLD CRM port additions (Commission module, Eligibility check, Export CSVs, Activity log). Backend pytest: 11/11 pass. Frontend: all 4 features verified end-to-end. (1) COMMISSION MODULE — GET /api/files/commissions returns 76 records, total_amount ₹873,638.25, by_growth_partner (26 entries, top: krishna sai ₹105,108.84 / 8 records; sorted desc), by_bank (1 entry: Unknown ₹873,638.25 / 76). GET /commissions/summary returns total_paid/total_count/pending_count/pending_estimated. UI panel data-testid='commission-report-panel' opens via top-bar Commission button, 'Load Commission Data' fetches & renders 4 KPI cards (₹8.7L / 76 / 26 / 1) + by_growth_partner table (top 10 rows) + by_bank table + Export button. (2) ELIGIBILITY CHECK — POST /api/files/{id}/check-eligibility runs against 27 policies, returns results[]/eligible_count/not_eligible_count/customer_data; persists eligibilities to lead doc and pushes file_activities entry. Verified on file 0d8133f3: 0 eligible / 27 not eligible (salary ₹34503 < min ₹35000). UI 'Check Bank Eligibility' green button in FileDetailsPage header triggers the API and populates 'Bank Eligibilities (27/7)' section with each bank card showing Bank Name, Eligible? select, Not Eligible Reason. (3) EXPORT REPORTS — /api/files/export/dashboard, /export/rejected, /export/growth-partner, /export/commissions all return 200 with content-type text/csv, correct Content-Disposition attachment, and expected column headers. Dashboard export has File ID/Name/Phone/Email/City/Status/Loan Type/CIBIL/etc. Rejected export has 'BANK-LEVEL REJECTION SUMMARY' + 'REJECTED FILES DETAIL' sections. GP export has Files (Current)/Files (Spillover)/Approved Amount/Disbursed Amount columns. UI Export dropdown in FilesDashboard shows all 4 options (Dashboard Export, Rejected Cases, Growth Partner, Commissions). (4) ACTIVITY LOG — After eligibility check, Activity Log panel on file detail shows new event 'Eligibility checked against 27 banks. 0 eligible. — Admin User • Just now' with clock icon; older 'File details updated' events also visible with colored borders. (5) AUTH GUARDS verified: /commissions and /export/dashboard return 401/403 without token.

minor.issue: by_bank aggregation groups ALL 76 commission records under 'Unknown' bucket because commission docs don't have bank_name set. Either backfill bank_name on commission records or add a UI note that bank breakdown is only available once bank_name is populated on commissions.

by_growth_partner shows raw UUID as source_name for 3 entries (95e19457-…, 638ece9e-…, 731d9a4f-…) — those source_ids reference deleted users, so user_map lookup falls back to the id itself. Consider joining against a soft-deleted users collection or storing source_name snapshot on the commission record at creation time.

issues: Persistent (from iter30): React hydration warnings — <span data-ve-dynamic> shim wraps <option>/<tr>/<tbody> inside <select>/<table> causing 'In HTML, span cannot be a child of select/tbody' warnings. Not functional but pollutes console.

Menu text renders as 'Growth PartnerPartners' in one place — appears to be text overlap between existing 'Growth Partner' shortcut header button label and the export menu item. Verify no duplicate rendering.

action_items: (Optional) Backfill bank_name on existing commission records so /commissions by_bank breakdown is meaningful (currently everything under 'Unknown').
(Optional) Store source_name snapshot on commission records at creation so deleted-user commissions don't show raw UUIDs.
(Optional carryover from iter30) Add auth (Depends(get_current_user)) to the still-open file mutation endpoints in files_crm.py — noted in iter27-30.
critical_code_review_comments: commissions/summary uses 2% flat estimator for pending commission — hardcoded magic number; expose as env var or per-bank rate.
Multiple export endpoints re-implement CSV writing via io.StringIO + csv.writer — extract a common helper.

check_bank_eligibility mutates leads.eligibilities in place but does NOT deduplicate against pre-existing manually-edited entries beyond bank_name match — running the check twice with new policies could leave stale entries.
files_crm.py still 3334 lines (was 2508 in iter30) — growing further; extract commissions/exports/eligibility into separate modules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Commission panel + eligibility button + export menu + activity log all functional)

seed_data_creation: None. Eligibility check was run on existing file 0d8133f3-2f35-40ae-8d08-71c0766b3170 (TEST_Iter29 Customer) which persisted 27 bank eligibility entries — pre-existing test data.

rca of the issue: N/A — all features work as designed. Minor data-quality observations: (a) by_bank grouping shows 'Unknown' because commission_type / bank_name fields are optional on CommissionCreate and were never populated when seeding the 76 records; (b) UUID display in by_growth_partner arises when user_map lookup fails for deleted user IDs — fix by snapshotting source_name at commission creation time (files_crm.py L1466 CommissionCreate).
